title: O standing still
blurb: The sanity check: O does not move. 4 D players clear all 12 O players in 4 ticks.

title: Moving O, 12 players
blurb: O flees the nearest D player while keeping its formation together. 4 D players win on the last tick.

title: Moving O, 20 players
blurb: The largest formation size. 7 D players clear all 20 O players in 4 ticks.

title: Without the nerve
blurb: Each D player hits its nearest O player with no coordination. Two D players hit the same O player, the second hit is wasted, and one O player survives.

title: With the nerve
blurb: Same formation, same 7 D players. Targets are matched across the nerve, so no hit is wasted and D wins in 4 ticks.
